description: Follow the release evaluation of a publish: its status, each policy's evaluation with its checker, enforcement, and status, each blocking finding with the file and line or package, the rule, and how to fix it, each finding of a monitor policy the same way (monitor findings never block), what deploy did with the release, and what to do next. Omit evaluation_id for the service's latest evaluation. Pass wait_seconds 20 to wait up to 20 seconds for the evaluation or the deploy to change before answering. While the answer carries retry_after_seconds, call again with wait_seconds 20: a passed evaluation's release goes live, and a blocked or errored one's is refused, shortly after. Requires connecting a Valet account.

evaluation_id.description: The release evaluation's id, from a publish. Omit to read the service's latest evaluation.

name.description: The website's, app's, agent's, or skill's name.

org_name.description: The Valet organization it belongs to. Omit to use the organization the account joined first.

wait_seconds.description: Seconds to wait for the evaluation's status or the deploy's state to change before answering; 0 answers at once. Use 20 while the answer carries retry_after_seconds.

name: get_evaluation

created_at.description: When the evaluation started, as an RFC 3339 time.

deploy_message.description: The message of deploy's refusal. Absent unless deploy refused the release.

deploy_state.description: What deploy did with the release: waiting for the evaluation, live, or the code of the refusal, such as deploy.policy_blocked, deploy.policy_errored, deploy.superseded, deploy.source_moved, or deleted. Absent when deploy state is unknown.

evaluation_id.description: The release evaluation's id. Pass it back as evaluation_id to keep following this evaluation.

evaluations.description: One entry per policy that evaluates the release. Empty while the evaluation has not started.

block_at.description: The lowest severity that blocks: info, low, medium, high, or critical. Absent for a monitor policy.

blocking.description: The findings this policy's enforcement blocks the release on. Fix each at its origin, then publish again.

fix.description: How to resolve the finding. Absent when the checker gives none.

line.description: The 1-based line of the finding in path. Absent when the finding has no line.

package.description: The dependency the finding is about, as a package URL such as pkg:npm/lodash@4.17.20. Absent for a file finding.

path.description: The file the finding is in, as <file set>/<path>, such as source/SOUL.md. Absent for a finding about a package or the whole release.

rule.description: The checker tool and its rule, such as gitleaks/slack-access-token.

severity.description: How serious the finding is: info, low, medium, high, or critical. A blocking policy blocks at its block_at severity or above.

url.description: A link to the checker's own page for the finding. Absent when it has none.

checker.description: The checker that backs the policy, such as catalog:secrets.

enforcement.description: What the policy's findings do: block stops a release with a finding at block_at or above, and monitor only records findings and never blocks.

error.description: Why the policy could not evaluate the release. Absent unless it errored.

findings.description: How many findings the checker reported, blocking or not.

monitor.description: Every finding of a monitor policy. They never block the release; offer to fix them.

fix.description: How to resolve the finding. Absent when the checker gives none.

line.description: The 1-based line of the finding in path. Absent when the finding has no line.

package.description: The dependency the finding is about, as a package URL such as pkg:npm/lodash@4.17.20. Absent for a file finding.

path.description: The file the finding is in, as <file set>/<path>, such as source/SOUL.md. Absent for a finding about a package or the whole release.

rule.description: The checker tool and its rule, such as gitleaks/slack-access-token.

severity.description: How serious the finding is: info, low, medium, high, or critical. A blocking policy blocks at its block_at severity or above.

url.description: A link to the checker's own page for the finding. Absent when it has none.

status.description: Where this policy's evaluation stands: pending, running, passed, blocked, errored (the checker failed or did not finish, never treated as a pass), removed (the policy was deleted or moved to another checker first), or canceled.

name.description: Name of the website, app, agent, or skill the release belongs to.

next_step.description: What to do next, in words.

org.description: Name of the Valet organization the call acted in.

retry_after_seconds.description: Seconds to wait before calling get_evaluation again, ideally with wait_seconds 20. Absent from a final answer, when the release is live or refused.

status.description: Where the release evaluation stands: running while any policy evaluation is unfinished, then passed, blocked, errored, or canceled. A canceled release never goes live.

title: Get a release evaluation
